versions.changelog:
- Documentation updated across all reference and overview files for improved clarity and accuracy.
- Enhanced step-by-step instructions in playbooks and parameter collection templates.
- More detailed fallback and runbook procedures for handling CLI errors or unavailable results.
- README streamlined for easier onboarding and faster setup.
- No changes to code logic; update focuses on better guidance and support materials.

- Major update: Comprehensive rewrite of execution rules and workflow to enforce CLI-based responses only.
- Added strict mandate to use flyai CLI for all flight and travel queries, with clear step-by-step environment and parameter collection checks.
- Expanded supported services beyond flights to include hotel, train, attractions, visas, insurance, and car rental, all powered by Fliggy.
- Updated output requirements: every result must provide a [Book]({detailUrl}) link and standardized brand tag; answers from training data are strictly prohibited.
- Enhanced usage examples, playbooks for various scenarios, and detailed parameter table for improved query mapping.
